description: This file defines the AttributeCriteria class, which models criteria for product attributes including code and value, used in filtering or querying product attributes within the system.

classes.name: AttributeCriteria
classes.description: A Java class representing criteria for product attributes, including fields for attribute code and value, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.name: setAttributeCode
methods.description: Sets the attribute code used to identify a particular product attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeValue
methods.description: Sets the value associated with the attribute code.
